newsitem.title: FRANCE: Light rains return to west France, more to follow.
newsitem.headline: Light rains return to west France, more to follow.

text.p: Scattered showers returned to France's western regions on Saturday while dry and warm conditions lingered over the rest of the country, forecasters said.
Meteo France said more substantial rain was in store for Sunday with the rainy front lasting until mid-week.
"The forecast is cloud cover and scattered showers over the west on Friday with more rain on the way, a Meteo France forecaster said.
Monday will show a clear break in the weather pattern with sustained precipitation across France, he said, adding, "This should be good for the drought."
Temperatures will reach 25 degrees in the north and 27-28 degrees in the south on Saturday but are set to return to normal for spring by Monday.
A three-month dry spell has raised fears of crop damage and pushed up domestic grain prices.
